source_supported_invariants.statement: A proxied producer keeps an original resource separately from its active proxy resource. Normal non-proxy XML filtering restores that original into resource (and warp_resource for timewarp), and removes proxy/original-resource markers from emitted properties.
source_supported_invariants.limitation: This describes existing code intent/behavior statically, not a maintainer demand and not a tested guarantee under corruption or an external replacement.

source_supported_invariants.statement: Proxy filenames and lookup use shotcut:hash plus a media extension. getHash reuses an existing stored hash; otherwise it hashes the original resource when proxied and writes the hash property. On explicit relink, the selected replacement path/hash are carried to rewritten resource/hash/caption and stream indices are updated when both hashes are nonempty and differ.
source_supported_invariants.limitation: Hash is MD5 over all bytes for files <=2,000,000 bytes and first/last 1,000,000 bytes for larger files. It is neither a full-content identity proof nor revalidated when a nonempty cached hash exists. util.cpp explicitly attributes the hashing routine to Kdenlive.

pre_change_interfaces.purpose: Resolve original media when proxy marker and original resource are present; otherwise ordinary/timewarp resource.
Build hash-derived pending media path in selected proxy directory and queue generation.
writes: Create/truncate <hash>.pending.mp4 or <hash>.pending.jpg in proxy directory; enqueue media-writing job.

pre_change_interfaces.purpose: Finalize pending filename; replacement action creates proxied producer, retains original resource, invokes MAIN.replaceAllByHash.
writes: Rename generated pending file to final media filename.
Set shotcut:proxy and shotcut:resource in producer; delegate replaceAllByHash.
Delete pending path on rename failure.
pre_change_interfaces.not_traced: MAIN.replaceAllByHash implementation was not fetched; no assertion of its detailed fan-out semantics.

pre_change_interfaces.purpose: Rewrite XML on load, substitute available proxy, apply replacement model and adjust hash/caption/stream metadata.
writes: In-memory replacement model, resource/hash/caption and stream properties.
utime calls touch proxy file timestamps.

pre_change_interfaces.purpose: Manual replacement and directory discovery populate MissingColumn/ReplacementColumn and ShotcutHashRole.
writes: Replacement path/hash and status icon in Qt model; Settings.setOpenPath for chosen directory.
pre_change_interfaces.important_boundary: lookInDir accepts hash match OR matching filename, marking differing-hash filename matches with warning icon. This is observed pre-change code, not evidence that auxiliary issue 910 used relinking.

pre_change_interfaces.purpose: Emit original-backed project XML; save through temporary file and backup/rename handling.
writes: Filtered temporary XML file with restored original resource and no proxy markers.
Target project XML via MLT xml consumer; optional initial temp, copy of existing target to backup, target removal and rename of validated temp, removal of backup on success.
